# USA TODAY SportsData

> > Comprehensive live scores, statistics, and updates for major professional and collegiate sports leagues including NFL, MLB, NBA, NHL, MLS, PGA Tour, NASCAR, Formula 1, and more.

USA TODAY SportsData provides real-time game scores, odds, team leaders, and live updates across all major sports. The platform covers professional leagues (NFL, MLB, NBA, NHL, MLS, WNBA), motorsports (NASCAR, IndyCar, Formula 1), golf tours (PGA, LPGA), international soccer (EPL), and combat sports (MMA).

## Key Topics

- Live sports scores and updates
- MLB (Major League Baseball)
- NFL (National Football League)
- NBA (National Basketball Association)
- NHL (National Hockey League)
- PGA Tour and LPGA golf
- NASCAR and IndyCar racing
- Formula 1
- MLS (Major League Soccer)
- EPL (English Premier League)
- WNBA
- MMA (Mixed Martial Arts)
- Real-time game statistics
- Sports betting odds
- Team performance data

## Major League Sports Scores

- [2025 NFL Scores & Live Updates - USA TODAY](https://sportsdata.usatoday.com/football/nfl/scores): Live NFL scores, odds, and team leaders for Week 23 of 2025 season
- [2026 MLB Scores & Live Updates - USA TODAY](https://sportsdata.usatoday.com/baseball/mlb/scores): Live MLB scores, odds, and team leaders for 2026 season games
